acceptanceCriteria: Every JS/TS test-source reader shares one test-file predicate that admits __tests__ path segments, or the spec records why a reader excludes them.
Tests cover a __tests__ file through lint and test-validity.
body: V1-2041 (PR #1307, TSA-V0-388) made test-validity count JS/TS files under a __tests__ path segment as test files without changing internal/testsource IsTestFile. Lint and the other readers that call IsTestFile still skip those files, so a Jest repository gets validity findings but no lint or other test-source analysis for its __tests__ files.

title: JS/TS lint and other test readers still use IsTestFile, so Jest __tests__ files are skipped outside test-validity
